props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name — what is being signed.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called after every finished stroke, with the current image.

props.name: weight
props.description: Nominal stroke width. Speed varies it either side of this.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour for the stroke. A `var(--token)` reference is resolved.

props.name: hint
props.defaultValue: 'Sign with a finger, a stylus or the mouse.'
